results.title: Ilana Glazer: Human Magic
results.overview: Ilana Glazer's unfiltered stand-up special dives into life's down and dirty truths, from painfully awkward high school years to navigating parenthood as a stoner mom.

results.title: Diary of an Alcoholic
results.overview: The feature film Diary of an Alcoholic tells the dramatic story of a young woman struggling with alcohol addiction. The main heroine (although she often does not act like a heroine) is a young mother who decided not to give up, to start treatment and to fight her demon and her family. How hard is it to admit a drinking problem? Why is not even a small child an obstacle to addiction? Where to get the strength to heal and what comes next? These and many other questions are answered by an authentic and honest cinematic confession of an abstinent alcoholic.

results.title: The Spell
results.overview: After being exploited by The Hand for far too long, a small group of seamstresses organizes a ritual to summon an occult power to achieve better working conditions for themselves. But is this power strong enough to overtake the might of The Hand?

results.title: Untold: Hope Solo vs. U.S. Soccer
results.original_title: Untold: Hope Solo vs. U.S. Soccer
results.overview: World Cup champion Hope Solo opens up about her turbulent rise to the top of women's soccer amid public scandals and tension with former teammates.

results.title: We, Women
results.overview: Silvia is a woman enclosed in the narrowness of patriarchal canons. She´s just 55, but she thinks that her life lacks of value. However, she will discover soon that she´s wrong

results.title: Driving Lessons
results.overview: Wartime Kyiv. A father helps his daughter to practice driving. They are the only relatives to each other and have a strong connection, but many disagreements in their opinions. The driving lesson ceases to be ordinary when the father is issued a summons at a checkpoint.

results.title: The Devil's Climb
results.overview: Climbers Alex Honnold and Tommy Caldwell set out on a daring expedition to tackle Alaska's formidable Devils Thumb. Battling harsh conditions and daunting peaks, they push their physical and mental limits, while their deep friendship faces its toughest trial yet.

results.title: Immunity
results.overview: In a hostile, post apocalyptic world, a helpless survivor must navigate an environment where friend and foe are not always clear.

results.title: La Cocina
results.overview: In the sweltering back kitchen of a Times Square restaurant, undocumented cook Pedro is caught between mounting pressures at work and a complicated romance with waitress Julia. When money goes missing, suspicion spreads, igniting tensions that threaten to upend the fragile hopes of the staff.

results.title: The Faint Clatter of Birds
results.overview: In 1978 Włodzimierz Puchalski sets off for Antarctica to fulfil his dream. The structural axis of the film is Puchalski's sea voyage to Antarctica, which was aborted by his death on 19 January 1979 on King George Island. It is interwoven with Puchalski's relationship with his daughter.

results.title: DREDD
results.overview: A struggling black actor's pursuit of a role spirals into a psychological descent, blurring the lines between his identity and the villain he portrays.

results.title: Bâtardes Glorieuses
results.overview: Julia and Nellie meet up regularly to carry out a mission of vengeance.

results.title: Backrider
results.overview: A private massage therapist. After a nasty break up with her gaming and crypto addicted boyfriend, she finds comfort in her rich, and seemingly kind client, but finds herself in a passionate and perilous situation.

results.title: Sugarcane
results.overview: An investigation into abuse and missing children at an Indian residential school in Canada ignites a reckoning on the nearby Sugarcane Reserve.

results.title: Dreaming Dogs
results.overview: A pack of strays – seven dogs and one woman live in the shadows of Moscow. Hidden from the totalitarian authorities, two species share their existence on the verge of disappearance. They are straying in constant restlessness through a savage landscape where the city is cracking. Shot from the animal’s point of view, patterns of mutual dependence and taming begin to blur.

results.title: Ephemeral
results.overview: Two inseparable girls forge a friendship that seemed unbreakable. But as time leads them to the crossroads of adulthood, their paths diverge, testing the bonds they thought were unshakeable.

results.title: Tato
results.overview: Welington wants to leave his past behind and make a living as a tattoo artist. But in the face of his desires, the need for survival imposes itself. Between tattoo sessions and work as a bricklayer, he struggles to live in a world where there is no future horizon.

results.title: Dark Saturday
results.overview: A young couple of actors is forced to face the problems of their relationship and their respective professional careers when their dog becomes seriously ill and they fear what will be the fate of all.

results.title: Schitterend
results.overview: 'Schitterend' tells the story of six women in different age phases, who all struggle in their own way with self-image, beauty and expectations from society.
